findings.text: The new test lies outside the node's FENCE - SCOPE list (prompt.txt:77-81), which names only dispatch_batch.py paths, the evidence fragment and the figures directory, so crew check --manifest refuses the reviewed record for changed paths outside the write scope. The plan's done-when and the EVIDENCE fence (prompt.txt:132) both require the file; the fix is to add that one path to the node's recorded scope rather than treat it as overreach.

The durable default manifest path is now computed a third time, inline, beside the same expression at reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:820-823 and the launch-time fallback at reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1016-1022. Extracting one helper would keep the doors from drifting on which directory a worker's manifest resolves; all three currently agree.

The fix only fills the path for entries queued after it lands, so the already-stored requests named in the plan's Why remain refused by crew queue edit until dropped and requeued, losing their queue position. A fallback in the contract check to run_dir(run_id)/manifest.md, as dispatch_sessions.py:1016 already does, would repair them in place.

The header names revision 25dd5d75d1a3 (the base) while the run was the head worktree with the assignment removed, so the negative control's provenance cannot be told apart from logs/prefix-red.log by its own header. The body and the distinct pytest basetemps (1142 vs 1143) show two separate executions, so the red result still stands.
